resources.string: Downloads the models for the Clackatoo keyboard\'s offline voice typing and grammar check, and hands them to the keyboard. You can also pick a model of your own from Hugging Face (experimental). The keyboard itself never connects to the internet.
Downloads you start from the Clackatoo keyboard or from Hugging Face appear here.
The file has the wrong size.
The file does not match its checksum.
Redirected to an address that is not trusted.
The Clackatoo keyboard did not accept the file.
Turn on \'Use your own model\' in Clackatoo\'s settings (Voice typing or Grammar check) first, then try again.
The file is too large for the keyboard.
This is not a model file the keyboard can use.
That file is not a %1$s model.
The keyboard could not load this model and removed it.
Delete a custom model in Clackatoo first.
Allow notifications to see the progress of downloads in the notification shade.

Models from Hugging Face are not checked by Clackatoo and may not work. Each model has its own licence. Search for a model or type a repository such as owner/name, pick a .gguf or .bin file and say what it is for.
This repository has no .gguf or .bin files up to 4 GB.
Could not reach Hugging Face. Check your connection and try again.
Hugging Face sent us to an address that is not trusted.
The answer from Hugging Face was too large.
Hugging Face does not have that repository.
Hugging Face did not answer. The repository may be private or the service busy.
The answer from Hugging Face could not be read.
The download could not be started.

Models from Hugging Face are experimental. Clackatoo has not checked them, they may not work, may be slow or use a lot of memory, and results may be poor. They run in a locked-down model process without internet and without access to what you type in other apps. This app only downloads the file you choose and gives it to the Clackatoo keyboard; you pick the model and the role yourself.
